selected_candidate.name: ROLE_CAPPAR_REL_INC_ZOE
selected_candidate.definition: Jointly canonicalize exact REL_INC residual incidence with one bit per local column equal to remaining-capacity parity (H-h_c mod 2); aggregate component multiplicities over equal descriptors; then apply ZOE to the aggregate count.
selected_candidate.selection_basis: It is the coarsest candidate in the predeclared ladder and has zero mixed scalar classes on every derivation carrier.

findings.statement: Attaching a capacity label to the same canonical column role as REL_INC closes the residual scalar collisions left by the unordered exact capacity profile on all four demanding derivation carriers.

One role-aligned remaining-capacity parity bit per local column is sufficient; the finer zero/positive-odd/positive-even and exact capacity labels are not required for Q-V exactness on the derivation corpus.
ROLE_CAPPAR_REL_INC_ZOE is strictly coarser than exact-type ZOE while preserving Q-V on every demanding derivation carrier.

Exact role-aligned capacity plus REL_INC reproduces the exact-type ZOE class count and scalar purity on every derivation carrier, validating the joint canonicalization as a reconstruction of exact component geometry up to the same local isomorphism.

nonclaims: ROLE_CAPPAR_REL_INC_ZOE is not yet fresh-qualified on 5x4-k4.
The role-aligned parity descriptor is not proved minimal among all whole-component structural identities.
Q-A and Q-F are not established.
